local mfl, mce, mmi = math.floor, math.ceil, math.min
local SegTree = {}
SegTree.updateAll = function(self)
  for i = self.stagenum - 1, 1, -1 do
    for j = 1, self.cnt[i] do
      self.stage[i][j] = self.func(self.stage[i + 1][j * 2 - 1], self.stage[i + 1][j * 2])
    end
  end
end
SegTree.create = function(self, n, func, emptyvalue)
  self.func, self.emptyvalue = func, emptyvalue
  local stagenum, mul = 1, 1
  self.cnt, self.stage, self.size = {1}, {{}}, {}
  while mul < n do
    mul, stagenum = mul * 2, stagenum + 1
    self.cnt[stagenum], self.stage[stagenum] = mul, {}
  end
  for i = 1, stagenum do self.size[i] = self.cnt[stagenum + 1 - i] end
  self.stagenum = stagenum

  -- for i = #ary + 1, mul do self.stage[stagenum][i] = emptyvalue end
  for i = 1, mul do self.stage[stagenum][i] = emptyvalue end
  self:updateAll()
end
SegTree.getRange = function(self, left, right)
  if left == right then return self.stage[self.stagenum][left] end
  local start_stage = 1
  while right - left + 1 < self.size[start_stage] do
    start_stage = start_stage + 1
  end
  local ret = self.emptyvalue
  local t1, t2, t3 = {start_stage}, {left}, {right}
  while 0 < #t1 do
    local stage, l, r = t1[#t1], t2[#t1], t3[#t1]
    table.remove(t1) table.remove(t2) table.remove(t3)
    local sz = self.size[stage]
    if (l - 1) % sz ~= 0 then
      local newr = mmi(r, mce((l - 1) / sz) * sz)
      table.insert(t1, stage + 1) table.insert(t2, l) table.insert(t3, newr)
      l = newr + 1
    end
    if sz <= r + 1 - l then
      ret = self.func(ret, self.stage[stage][mce(l / sz)])
      l = l + sz
    end
    if l <= r then
      table.insert(t1, stage + 1) table.insert(t2, l) table.insert(t3, r)
    end
  end
  return ret
end
SegTree.setValue = function(self, idx, value, silent)
  self.stage[self.stagenum][idx] = value
  if not silent then
    for i = self.stagenum - 1, 1, -1 do
      local dst = mce(idx / 2)
      local rem = dst * 4 - 1 - idx
      self.stage[i][dst] = self.func(self.stage[i + 1][idx], self.stage[i + 1][rem])
      idx = dst
    end
  end
end

SegTree.right_bound = function(self, val, left, right)
  local ret, retpos = self.emptyvalue, left - 1
  local t1, t2, t3 = {1}, {left}, {right}

    local stage, l, r = t1[#t1], t2[#t1], t3[#t1]
    table.remove(t1) table.remove(t2) table.remove(t3)
    local sz = self.size[stage]
    while (l - 1) % sz ~= 0 or r + 1 - l < sz do
      stage = stage + 1
      sz = self.size[stage]
    end
    local tmp = self.func(ret, self.stage[stage][mce(l / sz)])
    if tmp > val then
      ret, retpos = tmp, l + sz - 1
      if retpos == right then break end
      if l + sz <= r then table.insert(t1, 1) table.insert(t2, l + sz) table.insert(t3, r) end
    else
      if sz ~= 1 then table.insert(t1, stage + 1) table.insert(t2, l) table.insert(t3, l + sz - 2) end
    end
  end
  return retpos + 1
end

local function comp(a, b)
  return a < b
end

local function lower_bound(ary, x)
  local num = #ary
  if num == 0 then return 1 end
  if not comp(ary[1], x) then return 1 end
  if comp(ary[num], x) then return num + 1 end
  local min, max = 1, num
  while 1 < max - min do
    local mid = mfl((min + max) / 2)
    if comp(ary[mid], x) then
      min = mid
    else
      max = mid
    end
  end
  return max
end

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as_ <- getVecULn n $ rIntS
  bs_ <- getVecULn n $ rIntS
  (bs,as) <- fmap VU.unzip $ do
    bdl <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.zip bs_ as_
    vait_sort bdl
    VU.unsafeFreeze bdl
  putStrLn $ if query as bs then "Yes" else "No"
  return ()

query :: VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Bool
query as bs
  | VU.or $ VU.zipWith ((>) . snd) asI bs = False
  | cycleMoreThan2 $ VU.map fst asI = True
  | otherwise = VU.or $ VU.zipWith ((<=) . snd) (VU.tail asI) bs 
  where
    asI = VU.create $ do
      asI <- VU.thaw $ VU.indexed as
      vait_sortBy (compare `on` swap) asI
      return asI

cycleMoreThan2 :: VU.Vector Int -> Bool
cycleMoreThan2 vec = go (VU.length vec) (vec VU.! 0)
  where
    go !n 0 | n > 0 = True
            | otherwise = False
    go !n !i = go (n-1) (vec VU.! i)

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u

       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements to the front of the array in
-- no particular order.
vait_select
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vait_select = vait_selectBy compare
{-# INLINE vait_select #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array in no particular order.
vait_selectBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vait_selectBy cmp a k = vait_selectByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_selectBy #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements in the interval [l,u) to the positions
-- [l,k+l) in no particular order.
vait_selectByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower bound, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper bound, u
  -> m ()
vait_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l >= u    = return ()
  | otherwise = go (vait_ilg len) l (l + k) u
 where
 len = u - l
 go 0 l m u = vah_selectByBounds cmp a (m - l) l u
 go n l m u = do
   vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
   p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
   mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
   VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
   if | m > mid -> go (n-1) mid m u
      | m < mid - 1 -> go (n-1) l m (mid - 1)
      | otherwise -> return ()
  where c = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_selectByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements to the front of the array, sorted.
vait_partialSort
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vait_partialSort = vait_partialSortBy compare
{-# INLINE vait_partialSort #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array, sorted.
vait_partialSortBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vait_partialSortBy cmp a k
  = vait_partialSortByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_partialSortBy #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements in the interval [l,u) to the positions
-- [l,k+l), sorted.
vait_partialSortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_partialSortByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l >= u    = return ()
  | otherwise = go (vait_ilg len) l (l + k) u
 where
 isort = vait_introsort cmp a
 {-# INLINE [1] isort #-}
 len = u - l
 go 0 l m n = vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a (m - l) l u
 go n l m u
   | l == m    = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       case compare m mid of
         GT -> do isort (n-1) l (mid - 1)
                  go (n-1) mid m u
         EQ -> isort (n-1) l m
         LT -> go n l m (mid - 1)
  where c = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_partialSortByBounds #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

-- computes the number of recursive calls after which heapsort should
-- be invoked given the lower and upper indices of the array to be sorted
vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

-- the size of array at which the introsort algorithm switches to insertion sort
vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vah_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vah_sort = vah_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vah_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vah_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vah_sortBy cmp a = vah_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vah_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements to the front of the array.
-- The elements will be in no particular order.
vah_select
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vah_select = vah_selectBy compare
{-# INLINE vah_select #-}

-- | Moves the lowest (as defined by the comparison) k elements
-- to the front of the array. The elements will be in no particular
-- order.
vah_selectBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vah_selectBy cmp a k = vah_selectByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_selectBy #-}

-- | Moves the 'lowest' k elements in the portion [l,u) of the
-- array into the positions [l,k+l). The elements will be in
-- no particular order.
vah_selectByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l + k <= u = vah_heapify cmp a l (l + k) >> go l (l + k) (u - 1)
  | otherwise  = return ()
 where
 go l m u
   | u < m      = return ()
   | otherwise  = do
       el <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       eu <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp eu el of
         LT -> vah_popTo cmp a l m u
         _  -> return ()
       go l m (u - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_selectByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements to the front of the array, sorted.
--
-- The remaining values of the array will be in no particular order.
vah_partialSort
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vah_partialSort = vah_partialSortBy compare
{-# INLINE vah_partialSort #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array, sorted.
--
-- The remaining values of the array will be in no particular order.
vah_partialSortBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to vah_sort, k
  -> m ()
vah_partialSortBy cmp a k = vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_partialSortBy #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements in the portion [l,u) of the array
-- into positions [l,k+l), sorted.
--
-- The remaining values in [l,u) will be in no particular order. Values outside
-- the range [l,u) will be unaffected.
vah_partialSortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to vah_sort, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a k l u FILTER
  -- this potentially does more work than absolutely required,
  -- but using a heap to find the least 2 of 4 elements
  -- seems unlikely to be better than just sorting all of them
  -- with an optimal sort, and the latter is obviously index
  -- correct.
  | u <= l + k = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
  | otherwise  = do
      vah_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
      vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l + 4) (l + k)
      vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where
 len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_partialSortByBounds #-}

-- | Constructs a heap in a portion of an array [l, u), using the values
--   therein.
--
-- Note: 'vah_heapify' is more efficient than constructing a heap by repeated
-- insertion. Repeated insertion has complexity O(n*log n) while 'vah_heapify'
-- is able to construct a heap in O(n), where n is the number of elements in
-- the heap.
vah_heapify
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
 len = u - l
 loop k
   | k < 0     = return ()
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
                   vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u), swaps the
-- top of the heap with the element at u and rebuilds the heap.
vah_pop
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u) swaps the top
-- of the heap with the element at position t, and rebuilds the heap.
vah_popTo
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> Int -- ^ index to vah_pop to, t
  -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u), sorts the
-- highest values into [m,u). The elements in [l,m) are not in any
-- particular order.
vah_sortHeap
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ lower bound of final sorted portion, m
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u) and an element e,
-- inserts the element into the heap, resulting in a heap in [l,u].
--
-- Note: it is best to only use this operation when incremental construction of
-- a heap is required. 'vah_heapify' is capable of building a heap in O(n) time,
-- while repeated insertion takes O(n*log n) time.
vah_heapInsert
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> e -- ^ element to be inserted, e
  -> m ()
vah_heapInsert cmp v l u e = sift (u - l)
 where
 sift k
   | k <= 0    = VGM.unsafeWrite v l e
   | otherwise = let pi = l + shiftR (k-1) 2
                  in VGM.unsafeRead v pi >>= \p -> case cmp p e of
                       LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite v (l + k) p >> sift pi
                       _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite v (l + k) e
{-# INLINE vah_heapInsert #-}

-- Rebuilds a heap with a hole in it from start downwards. Afterward,
-- the heap property should apply for [start + off, len + off). val
-- is the new value to be put in the hole.
vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac
               >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

-- Finds the maximum child of a heap node, given the indx of the first child.
vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default comparison for the type
vais_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) =>
  v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vais_sort = vais_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vais_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a given comparison
vais_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vais_sortBy cmp a = vais_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vais_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of an array delimited by [l,u)
vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of the array delimited by [l,u) under the assumption
-- that [l,m) is already sorted.
vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

-- Given a sorted array in [l,u), inserts val into its proper position,
-- yielding a sorted [l,u]
vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

-- | Sorts the elements at the positions 'off' and 'off + 1' in the given
-- array using the comparison.
vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}


-- | Sorts the elements at the two given indices using the comparison. This
-- is essentially a compare-and-swap, although the first index is assumed to
-- be the 'lower' of the two.
vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the three elements starting at the given offset in the array.
vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the three given indices. The indices are assumed
-- to be given from lowest to highest, so if 'l < m < u' then
-- 'vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a m l u' essentially sorts the median of three into the
-- lowest position in the array.
vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the four elements beginning at the offset.
vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

-- The horror...

-- | Sorts the elements at the four given indices. Like the 2 and 3 element
-- versions, this assumes that the indices are given in increasing order, so
-- it can be used to sort medians into particular positions and so on.
vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as_ <- getVecULn n $ rIntS
  bs_ <- getVecULn n $ rIntS
  (bs,as) <- fmap VU.unzip $ do
    bdl <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.zip bs_ as_
    vait_sort bdl
    VU.unsafeFreeze bdl
  putStrLn $ if query as bs then "Yes" else "No"
  return ()

query :: VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Bool
query as bs
  | VU.or $ VU.zipWith (>) asP bs = False
  | cycleMoreThan2 $ VU.map fst is = True
  | otherwise = VU.or $ VU.zipWith (<=) (VU.tail asP) bs 
  where
    (is,asP) = VU.unzip $ VU.create $ do
      asI <- VU.thaw $ VU.indexed as
      vait_sortBy (compare `on` swap) asI
      return asI

cycleMoreThan2 :: VU.Vector Int -> Bool
cycleMoreThan2 vec = go (VU.length vec - 1) (vec VU.! 0)
  where
    go !n 0 | n > 0 = True
            | otherwise = False
    go !n !i = go (n-1) (vec VU.! i)

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements to the front of the array in
-- no particular order.
vait_select
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vait_select = vait_selectBy compare
{-# INLINE vait_select #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array in no particular order.
vait_selectBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vait_selectBy cmp a k = vait_selectByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_selectBy #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements in the interval [l,u) to the positions
-- [l,k+l) in no particular order.
vait_selectByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower bound, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper bound, u
  -> m ()
vait_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l >= u    = return ()
  | otherwise = go (vait_ilg len) l (l + k) u
 where
 len = u - l
 go 0 l m u = vah_selectByBounds cmp a (m - l) l u
 go n l m u = do
   vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
   p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
   mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
   VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
   if | m > mid -> go (n-1) mid m u
      | m < mid - 1 -> go (n-1) l m (mid - 1)
      | otherwise -> return ()
  where c = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_selectByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements to the front of the array, sorted.
vait_partialSort
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vait_partialSort = vait_partialSortBy compare
{-# INLINE vait_partialSort #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array, sorted.
vait_partialSortBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vait_partialSortBy cmp a k
  = vait_partialSortByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_partialSortBy #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements in the interval [l,u) to the positions
-- [l,k+l), sorted.
vait_partialSortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_partialSortByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l >= u    = return ()
  | otherwise = go (vait_ilg len) l (l + k) u
 where
 isort = vait_introsort cmp a
 {-# INLINE [1] isort #-}
 len = u - l
 go 0 l m n = vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a (m - l) l u
 go n l m u
   | l == m    = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       case compare m mid of
         GT -> do isort (n-1) l (mid - 1)
                  go (n-1) mid m u
         EQ -> isort (n-1) l m
         LT -> go n l m (mid - 1)
  where c = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_partialSortByBounds #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

-- computes the number of recursive calls after which heapsort should
-- be invoked given the lower and upper indices of the array to be sorted
vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

-- the size of array at which the introsort algorithm switches to insertion sort
vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vah_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vah_sort = vah_sortBy compare

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vah_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)

vah_sortBy cmp a = vah_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vah_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements to the front of the array.
-- The elements will be in no particular order.
vah_select
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vah_select = vah_selectBy compare
{-# INLINE vah_select #-}

-- | Moves the lowest (as defined by the comparison) k elements
-- to the front of the array. The elements will be in no particular
-- order.
vah_selectBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vah_selectBy cmp a k = vah_selectByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_selectBy #-}

-- | Moves the 'lowest' k elements in the portion [l,u) of the
-- array into the positions [l,k+l). The elements will be in
-- no particular order.
vah_selectByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l + k <= u = vah_heapify cmp a l (l + k) >> go l (l + k) (u - 1)
  | otherwise  = return ()
 where
 go l m u
   | u < m      = return ()
   | otherwise  = do
       el <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       eu <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp eu el of
         LT -> vah_popTo cmp a l m u
         _  -> return ()
       go l m (u - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_selectByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements to the front of the array, sorted.
--
-- The remaining values of the array will be in no particular order.
vah_partialSort
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vah_partialSort = vah_partialSortBy compare
{-# INLINE vah_partialSort #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array, sorted.
--
-- The remaining values of the array will be in no particular order.
vah_partialSortBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to vah_sort, k
  -> m ()
vah_partialSortBy cmp a k = vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_partialSortBy #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements in the portion [l,u) of the array
-- into positions [l,k+l), sorted.
--
-- The remaining values in [l,u) will be in no particular order. Values outside
-- the range [l,u) will be unaffected.
vah_partialSortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to vah_sort, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a k l u FILTER
  -- this potentially does more work than absolutely required,
  -- but using a heap to find the least 2 of 4 elements
  -- seems unlikely to be better than just sorting all of them
  -- with an optimal sort, and the latter is obviously index
  -- correct.
  | u <= l + k = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
  | otherwise  = do
      vah_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
      vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l + 4) (l + k)
      vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where
 len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_partialSortByBounds #-}

-- | Constructs a heap in a portion of an array [l, u), using the values
--   therein.
--
-- Note: 'vah_heapify' is more efficient than constructing a heap by repeated
-- insertion. Repeated insertion has complexity O(n*log n) while 'vah_heapify'
-- is able to construct a heap in O(n), where n is the number of elements in
-- the heap.
vah_heapify
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
 len = u - l
 loop k
   | k < 0     = return ()
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
                   vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u), swaps the
-- top of the heap with the element at u and rebuilds the heap.
vah_pop
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u) swaps the top
-- of the heap with the element at position t, and rebuilds the heap.
vah_popTo
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> Int -- ^ index to vah_pop to, t
  -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u), sorts the
-- highest values into [m,u). The elements in [l,m) are not in any
-- particular order.
vah_sortHeap
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ lower bound of final sorted portion, m
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u) and an element e,
-- inserts the element into the heap, resulting in a heap in [l,u].
--
-- Note: it is best to only use this operation when incremental construction of
-- a heap is required. 'vah_heapify' is capable of building a heap in O(n) time,
-- while repeated insertion takes O(n*log n) time.
vah_heapInsert
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> e -- ^ element to be inserted, e
  -> m ()
vah_heapInsert cmp v l u e = sift (u - l)
 where
 sift k
   | k <= 0    = VGM.unsafeWrite v l e
   | otherwise = let pi = l + shiftR (k-1) 2
                  in VGM.unsafeRead v pi >>= \p -> case cmp p e of
                       LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite v (l + k) p >> sift pi
                       _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite v (l + k) e
{-# INLINE vah_heapInsert #-}

-- Rebuilds a heap with a hole in it from start downwards. Afterward,
-- the heap property should apply for [start + off, len + off). val
-- is the new value to be put in the hole.
vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac
               >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

-- Finds the maximum child of a heap node, given the indx of the first child.
vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default comparison for the type
vais_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) =>
  v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vais_sort = vais_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vais_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a given comparison
vais_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vais_sortBy cmp a = vais_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vais_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of an array delimited by [l,u)
vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of the array delimited by [l,u) under the assumption
-- that [l,m) is already sorted.
vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

-- Given a sorted array in [l,u), inserts val into its proper position,
-- yielding a sorted [l,u]
vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

-- | Sorts the elements at the positions 'off' and 'off + 1' in the given
-- array using the comparison.
vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}


-- | Sorts the elements at the two given indices using the comparison. This
-- is essentially a compare-and-swap, although the first index is assumed to
-- be the 'lower' of the two.
vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the three elements starting at the given offset in the array.
vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the three given indices. The indices are assumed
-- to be given from lowest to highest, so if 'l < m < u' then
-- 'vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a m l u' essentially sorts the median of three into the
-- lowest position in the array.
vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the four elements beginning at the offset.
vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

-- The horror...

-- | Sorts the elements at the four given indices. Like the 2 and 3 element
-- versions, this assumes that the indices are given in increasing order, so
-- it can be used to sort medians into particular positions and so on.
vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

vac_midPoint :: Int -> Int -> Int
vac_midPoint a b =
  toInt $ (toWord a + toWord b) `div` 2
  where
    toWord :: Int -> Word
    toWord = fromIntegral

    toInt :: Word -> Int
    toInt = fromIntegral
{-# INLINE vac_midPoint #-}

vecToBuilder :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


{-# INLINE vecToBuilder_ #-}
vecToBuilder_ :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct vec
  = prefix <> VG.foldr
    (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
    (const postfix) vec mempty

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as_ <- getVecULn n $ rIntS
  bs_ <- getVecULn n $ rIntS
  (bs,as) <- fmap VU.unzip $ do
    bdl <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.zip bs_ as_
    vait_sort bdl
    VU.unsafeFreeze bdl
  putStrLn $ if query as bs then "Yes" else "No"
  return ()

query :: VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Bool
query as bs
  | VU.or $ VU.zipWith (>) asP bs = False
  | cycleMoreThan2 is = True
  | otherwise = VU.or $ VU.zipWith (<=) (VU.tail asP) bs 
  where
    (is,asP) = VU.unzip $ VU.create $ do
      asI <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.indexed as
      vait_sortBy (compare `on` swap) asI
      return asI

cycleMoreThan2 :: VU.Vector Int -> Bool
cycleMoreThan2 vec = go (VU.length vec - 1) (vec VU.! 0)
  where
    go !n 0 | n > 0 = True
            | otherwise = False
    go !n !i = go (n-1) (vec VU.! i)

#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements to the front of the array in
-- no particular order.
vait_select
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vait_select = vait_selectBy compare
{-# INLINE vait_select #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array in no particular order.
vait_selectBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vait_selectBy cmp a k = vait_selectByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_selectBy #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements in the interval [l,u) to the positions
-- [l,k+l) in no particular order.
vait_selectByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower bound, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper bound, u
  -> m ()
vait_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l >= u    = return ()
  | otherwise = go (vait_ilg len) l (l + k) u
 where
 len = u - l
 go 0 l m u = vah_selectByBounds cmp a (m - l) l u
 go n l m u = do
   vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
   p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
   mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
   VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
   if | m > mid -> go (n-1) mid m u
      | m < mid - 1 -> go (n-1) l m (mid - 1)
      | otherwise -> return ()
  where c = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_selectByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements to the front of the array, sorted.
vait_partialSort
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vait_partialSort = vait_partialSortBy compare
{-# INLINE vait_partialSort #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array, sorted.
vait_partialSortBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vait_partialSortBy cmp a k
  = vait_partialSortByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_partialSortBy #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements in the interval [l,u) to the positions
-- [l,k+l), sorted.
vait_partialSortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_partialSortByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l >= u    = return ()
  | otherwise = go (vait_ilg len) l (l + k) u
 where
 isort = vait_introsort cmp a
 {-# INLINE [1] isort #-}
 len = u - l
 go 0 l m n = vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a (m - l) l u
 go n l m u
   | l == m    = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       case compare m mid of
         GT -> do isort (n-1) l (mid - 1)
                  go (n-1) mid m u
         EQ -> isort (n-1) l m
         LT -> go n l m (mid - 1)
  where c = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_partialSortByBounds #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

-- computes the number of recursive calls after which heapsort should
-- be invoked given the lower and upper indices of the array to be sorted
vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

-- the size of array at which the introsort algorithm switches to insertion sort
vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vah_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vah_sort = vah_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vah_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vah_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vah_sortBy cmp a = vah_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vah_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements to the front of the array.
-- The elements will be in no particular order.
vah_select
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vah_select = vah_selectBy compare
{-# INLINE vah_select #-}

-- | Moves the lowest (as defined by the comparison) k elements
-- to the front of the array. The elements will be in no particular
-- order.
vah_selectBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vah_selectBy cmp a k = vah_selectByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_selectBy #-}

-- | Moves the 'lowest' k elements in the portion [l,u) of the
-- array into the positions [l,k+l). The elements will be in
-- no particular order.
vah_selectByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l + k <= u = vah_heapify cmp a l (l + k) >> go l (l + k) (u - 1)
  | otherwise  = return ()
 where
 go l m u
   | u < m      = return ()
   | otherwise  = do
       el <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       eu <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp eu el of
         LT -> vah_popTo cmp a l m u
         _  -> return ()
       go l m (u - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_selectByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements to the front of the array, sorted.
--
-- The remaining values of the array will be in no particular order.
vah_partialSort
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vah_partialSort = vah_partialSortBy compare
{-# INLINE vah_partialSort #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array, sorted.
--
-- The remaining values of the array will be in no particular order.
vah_partialSortBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to vah_sort, k
  -> m ()
vah_partialSortBy cmp a k = vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_partialSortBy #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements in the portion [l,u) of the array
-- into positions [l,k+l), sorted.
--
-- The remaining values in [l,u) will be in no particular order. Values outside
-- the range [l,u) will be unaffected.
vah_partialSortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to vah_sort, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a k l u FILTER
  -- this potentially does more work than absolutely required,
  -- but using a heap to find the least 2 of 4 elements
  -- seems unlikely to be better than just sorting all of them
  -- with an optimal sort, and the latter is obviously index
  -- correct.
  | u <= l + k = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
  | otherwise  = do
      vah_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
      vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l + 4) (l + k)
      vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where
 len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_partialSortByBounds #-}

-- | Constructs a heap in a portion of an array [l, u), using the values
--   therein.
--
-- Note: 'vah_heapify' is more efficient than constructing a heap by repeated
-- insertion. Repeated insertion has complexity O(n*log n) while 'vah_heapify'
-- is able to construct a heap in O(n), where n is the number of elements in
-- the heap.
vah_heapify
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
 len = u - l
 loop k
   | k < 0     = return ()
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
                   vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u), swaps the
-- top of the heap with the element at u and rebuilds the heap.
vah_pop
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u) swaps the top
-- of the heap with the element at position t, and rebuilds the heap.
vah_popTo
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> Int -- ^ index to vah_pop to, t
  -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u), sorts the
-- highest values into [m,u). The elements in [l,m) are not in any
-- particular order.
vah_sortHeap
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ lower bound of final sorted portion, m
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u) and an element e,
-- inserts the element into the heap, resulting in a heap in [l,u].
--
-- Note: it is best to only use this operation when incremental construction of
-- a heap is required. 'vah_heapify' is capable of building a heap in O(n) time,
-- while repeated insertion takes O(n*log n) time.
vah_heapInsert
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> e -- ^ element to be inserted, e
  -> m ()
vah_heapInsert cmp v l u e = sift (u - l)
 where
 sift k
   | k <= 0    = VGM.unsafeWrite v l e
   | otherwise = let pi = l + shiftR (k-1) 2
                  in VGM.unsafeRead v pi >>= \p -> case cmp p e of
                       LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite v (l + k) p >> sift pi
                       _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite v (l + k) e
{-# INLINE vah_heapInsert #-}

-- Rebuilds a heap with a hole in it from start downwards. Afterward,
-- the heap property should apply for [start + off, len + off). val
-- is the new value to be put in the hole.
vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac
               >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

-- Finds the maximum child of a heap node, given the indx of the first child.
vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default comparison for the type
vais_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) =>
  v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vais_sort = vais_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vais_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a given comparison
vais_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vais_sortBy cmp a = vais_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vais_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of an array delimited by [l,u)
vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of the array delimited by [l,u) under the assumption
-- that [l,m) is already sorted.
vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

-- Given a sorted array in [l,u), inserts val into its proper position,
-- yielding a sorted [l,u]
vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

-- | Sorts the elements at the positions 'off' and 'off + 1' in the given
-- array using the comparison.
vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}


-- | Sorts the elements at the two given indices using the comparison. This
-- is essentially a compare-and-swap, although the first index is assumed to
-- be the 'lower' of the two.
vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the three elements starting at the given offset in the array.
vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the three given indices. The indices are assumed
-- to be given from lowest to highest, so if 'l < m < u' then
-- 'vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a m l u' essentially sorts the median of three into the
-- lowest position in the array.
vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the four elements beginning at the offset.
vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

-- The horror...

-- | Sorts the elements at the four given indices. Like the 2 and 3 element
-- versions, this assumes that the indices are given in increasing order, so
-- it can be used to sort medians into particular positions and so on.
vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

vecToBuilder :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


{-# INLINE vecToBuilder_ #-}
vecToBuilder_ :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct vec
  = prefix <> VG.foldr
    (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
    (const postfix) vec mempty

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as_ <- getVecULn n $ rIntS
  bs_ <- getVecULn n $ rIntS
  (bs,as) <- fmap VU.unzip $ do
    bdl <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.zip bs_ as_
    vait_sort bdl
    VU.unsafeFreeze bdl
  putStrLn $ if query as bs then "Yes" else "No"
  return ()

query :: VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Bool
query as bs
  | VU.or $ VU.zipWith ((>) . snd) asI bs = False
  | cycleMoreThan2 $ VU.map fst asI = True
  | otherwise = VU.or $ VU.zipWith ((<=) . snd) (VU.tail asI) bs 
  where
    asI = VU.create $ do
      asI <- VU.thaw $ VU.indexed as
      vait_sortBy (compare `on` swap) asI
      return asI

cycleMoreThan2 :: VU.Vector Int -> Bool
cycleMoreThan2 vec = go (VU.length vec - 1) (vec VU.! 0)
  where
    go !n 0 | n > 0 = True
            | otherwise = False
    go !n !i = go (n-1) (vec VU.! i)
