#define FILTER \
  | len < 2   = return ()\
  | len == 2  = vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 3  = vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a l\
  | len == 4  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
#define FILTERED FILTER | otherwise

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements to the front of the array in
-- no particular order.
vait_select
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vait_select = vait_selectBy compare
{-# INLINE vait_select #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array in no particular order.
vait_selectBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vait_selectBy cmp a k = vait_selectByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_selectBy #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements in the interval [l,u) to the positions
-- [l,k+l) in no particular order.
vait_selectByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower bound, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper bound, u
  -> m ()
vait_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l >= u    = return ()
  | otherwise = go (vait_ilg len) l (l + k) u
 where
 len = u - l
 go 0 l m u = vah_selectByBounds cmp a (m - l) l u
 go n l m u = do
   vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
   p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
   mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
   VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
   if | m > mid -> go (n-1) mid m u
      | m < mid - 1 -> go (n-1) l m (mid - 1)
      | otherwise -> return ()
  where c = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_selectByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements to the front of the array, sorted.
vait_partialSort
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vait_partialSort = vait_partialSortBy compare
{-# INLINE vait_partialSort #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array, sorted.
vait_partialSortBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vait_partialSortBy cmp a k
  = vait_partialSortByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_partialSortBy #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements in the interval [l,u) to the positions
-- [l,k+l), sorted.
vait_partialSortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_partialSortByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l >= u    = return ()
  | otherwise = go (vait_ilg len) l (l + k) u
 where
 isort = vait_introsort cmp a
 {-# INLINE [1] isort #-}
 len = u - l
 go 0 l m n = vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a (m - l) l u
 go n l m u
   | l == m    = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       case compare m mid of
         GT -> do isort (n-1) l (mid - 1)
                  go (n-1) mid m u
         EQ -> isort (n-1) l m
         LT -> go n l m (mid - 1)
  where c = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_partialSortByBounds #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

-- computes the number of recursive calls after which heapsort should
-- be invoked given the lower and upper indices of the array to be sorted
vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

-- the size of array at which the introsort algorithm switches to insertion sort
vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vah_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vah_sort = vah_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vah_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vah_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vah_sortBy cmp a = vah_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vah_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements to the front of the array.
-- The elements will be in no particular order.
vah_select
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vah_select = vah_selectBy compare
{-# INLINE vah_select #-}

-- | Moves the lowest (as defined by the comparison) k elements
-- to the front of the array. The elements will be in no particular
-- order.
vah_selectBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vah_selectBy cmp a k = vah_selectByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_selectBy #-}

-- | Moves the 'lowest' k elements in the portion [l,u) of the
-- array into the positions [l,k+l). The elements will be in
-- no particular order.
vah_selectByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l + k <= u = vah_heapify cmp a l (l + k) >> go l (l + k) (u - 1)
  | otherwise  = return ()
 where
 go l m u
   | u < m      = return ()
   | otherwise  = do
       el <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       eu <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp eu el of
         LT -> vah_popTo cmp a l m u
         _  -> return ()
       go l m (u - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_selectByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements to the front of the array, sorted.
--
-- The remaining values of the array will be in no particular order.
vah_partialSort
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vah_partialSort = vah_partialSortBy compare
{-# INLINE vah_partialSort #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array, sorted.
--
-- The remaining values of the array will be in no particular order.
vah_partialSortBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to vah_sort, k
  -> m ()
vah_partialSortBy cmp a k = vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_partialSortBy #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements in the portion [l,u) of the array
-- into positions [l,k+l), sorted.
--
-- The remaining values in [l,u) will be in no particular order. Values outside
-- the range [l,u) will be unaffected.
vah_partialSortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to vah_sort, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a k l u FILTER
  -- this potentially does more work than absolutely required,
  -- but using a heap to find the least 2 of 4 elements
  -- seems unlikely to be better than just sorting all of them
  -- with an optimal sort, and the latter is obviously index
  -- correct.
  | u <= l + k = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
  | otherwise  = do
      vah_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
      vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l + 4) (l + k)
      vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where
 len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_partialSortByBounds #-}

-- | Constructs a heap in a portion of an array [l, u), using the values
--   therein.
--
-- Note: 'vah_heapify' is more efficient than constructing a heap by repeated
-- insertion. Repeated insertion has complexity O(n*log n) while 'vah_heapify'
-- is able to construct a heap in O(n), where n is the number of elements in
-- the heap.
vah_heapify
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
 len = u - l
 loop k
   | k < 0     = return ()
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
                   vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u), swaps the
-- top of the heap with the element at u and rebuilds the heap.
vah_pop
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u) swaps the top
-- of the heap with the element at position t, and rebuilds the heap.
vah_popTo
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> Int -- ^ index to vah_pop to, t
  -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u), sorts the
-- highest values into [m,u). The elements in [l,m) are not in any
-- particular order.
vah_sortHeap
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ lower bound of final sorted portion, m
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u) and an element e,
-- inserts the element into the heap, resulting in a heap in [l,u].
--
-- Note: it is best to only use this operation when incremental construction of
-- a heap is required. 'vah_heapify' is capable of building a heap in O(n) time,
-- while repeated insertion takes O(n*log n) time.
vah_heapInsert
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> e -- ^ element to be inserted, e
  -> m ()
vah_heapInsert cmp v l u e = sift (u - l)
 where
 sift k
   | k <= 0    = VGM.unsafeWrite v l e
   | otherwise = let pi = l + shiftR (k-1) 2
                  in VGM.unsafeRead v pi >>= \p -> case cmp p e of
                       LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite v (l + k) p >> sift pi
                       _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite v (l + k) e
{-# INLINE vah_heapInsert #-}

-- Rebuilds a heap with a hole in it from start downwards. Afterward,
-- the heap property should apply for [start + off, len + off). val
-- is the new value to be put in the hole.
vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac
               >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

-- Finds the maximum child of a heap node, given the indx of the first child.
vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default comparison for the type
vais_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) =>
  v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vais_sort = vais_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vais_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a given comparison
vais_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vais_sortBy cmp a = vais_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vais_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of an array delimited by [l,u)
vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of the array delimited by [l,u) under the assumption
-- that [l,m) is already sorted.
vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

-- Given a sorted array in [l,u), inserts val into its proper position,
-- yielding a sorted [l,u]
vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

-- | Sorts the elements at the positions 'off' and 'off + 1' in the given
-- array using the comparison.
vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}


-- | Sorts the elements at the two given indices using the comparison. This
-- is essentially a compare-and-swap, although the first index is assumed to
-- be the 'lower' of the two.
vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the three elements starting at the given offset in the array.
vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the three given indices. The indices are assumed
-- to be given from lowest to highest, so if 'l < m < u' then
-- 'vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a m l u' essentially sorts the median of three into the
-- lowest position in the array.
vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the four elements beginning at the offset.
vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

-- The horror...

-- | Sorts the elements at the four given indices. Like the 2 and 3 element
-- versions, this assumes that the indices are given in increasing order, so
-- it can be used to sort medians into particular positions and so on.
vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

vecToBuilder :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BS.ByteString -- ^ prefix
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ separator
  -> BS.ByteString -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder !prefix !separator !postfix
  = vecToBuilder_ (BSB.byteString prefix)
                  (BSB.byteString separator)
                  (BSB.byteString postfix)


{-# INLINE vecToBuilder_ #-}
vecToBuilder_ :: (VG.Vector v a)
  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ separator
  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder
vecToBuilder_ !prefix !separator !postfix showFct vec
  = prefix <> VG.foldr
    (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
    (const postfix) vec mempty

main :: IO ()
main = do
  n <- readInt <$> getLine
  as_ <- getVecULn n $ rIntS
  bs_ <- getVecULn n $ rIntS
  (bs,as) <- fmap VU.unzip $ do
    bdl <- VU.unsafeThaw $ VU.zip bs_ as_
    vait_sort bdl
    VU.unsafeFreeze bdl
  putStrLn $ if query as bs then "Yes" else "No"
  return ()

query :: VU.Vector Int -> VU.Vector Int -> Bool
query as bs
  | VU.or $ VU.zipWith (>) asP bs = False
  | cycleMoreThan2 is = True
  | otherwise = VU.or $ VU.zipWith (<=) (VU.tail asP) bs 
  where
    (is,asP) = VU.unzip $ VU.create $ do
      asI <- VU.thaw $ VU.indexed as
      vait_sortBy (compare `on` swap) asI
      return asI

cycleMoreThan2 :: VU.Vector Int -> Bool
cycleMoreThan2 vec = go (VU.length vec - 1) (vec VU.! 0)
  where
    go !n 0 | n > 0 = True
            | otherwise = False
    go !n !i = go (n-1) (vec VU.! i)

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements to the front of the array in
-- no particular order.
vait_select
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vait_select = vait_selectBy compare
{-# INLINE vait_select #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array in no particular order.
vait_selectBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vait_selectBy cmp a k = vait_selectByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_selectBy #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements in the interval [l,u) to the positions
-- [l,k+l) in no particular order.
vait_selectByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower bound, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper bound, u
  -> m ()
vait_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l >= u    = return ()
  | otherwise = go (vait_ilg len) l (l + k) u
 where
 len = u - l
 go 0 l m u = vah_selectByBounds cmp a (m - l) l u
 go n l m u = do
   vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
   p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
   mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
   VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
   if | m > mid -> go (n-1) mid m u
      | m < mid - 1 -> go (n-1) l m (mid - 1)
      | otherwise -> return ()
  where c = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_selectByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements to the front of the array, sorted.
vait_partialSort
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vait_partialSort = vait_partialSortBy compare
{-# INLINE vait_partialSort #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array, sorted.
vait_partialSortBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vait_partialSortBy cmp a k
  = vait_partialSortByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_partialSortBy #-}

-- | Moves the least k elements in the interval [l,u) to the positions
-- [l,k+l), sorted.
vait_partialSortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_partialSortByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l >= u    = return ()
  | otherwise = go (vait_ilg len) l (l + k) u
 where
 isort = vait_introsort cmp a
 {-# INLINE [1] isort #-}
 len = u - l
 go 0 l m n = vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a (m - l) l u
 go n l m u
   | l == m    = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       case compare m mid of
         GT -> do isort (n-1) l (mid - 1)
                  go (n-1) mid m u
         EQ -> isort (n-1) l m
         LT -> go n l m (mid - 1)
  where c = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_partialSortByBounds #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

-- computes the number of recursive calls after which heapsort should
-- be invoked given the lower and upper indices of the array to be sorted
vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

-- the size of array at which the introsort algorithm switches to insertion sort
vait_threshold :: Int
vait_threshold = 18
{-# INLINE vait_threshold #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vah_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vah_sort = vah_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vah_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vah_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vah_sortBy cmp a = vah_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vah_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements to the front of the array.
-- The elements will be in no particular order.
vah_select
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vah_select = vah_selectBy compare
{-# INLINE vah_select #-}

-- | Moves the lowest (as defined by the comparison) k elements
-- to the front of the array. The elements will be in no particular
-- order.
vah_selectBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> m ()
vah_selectBy cmp a k = vah_selectByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_selectBy #-}

-- | Moves the 'lowest' k elements in the portion [l,u) of the
-- array into the positions [l,k+l). The elements will be in
-- no particular order.
vah_selectByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to select, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
  | l + k <= u = vah_heapify cmp a l (l + k) >> go l (l + k) (u - 1)
  | otherwise  = return ()
 where
 go l m u
   | u < m      = return ()
   | otherwise  = do
       el <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       eu <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp eu el of
         LT -> vah_popTo cmp a l m u
         _  -> return ()
       go l m (u - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_selectByBounds #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements to the front of the array, sorted.
--
-- The remaining values of the array will be in no particular order.
vah_partialSort
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to sort, k
  -> m ()
vah_partialSort = vah_partialSortBy compare
{-# INLINE vah_partialSort #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements (as defined by the comparison) to
-- the front of the array, sorted.
--
-- The remaining values of the array will be in no particular order.
vah_partialSortBy
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to vah_sort, k
  -> m ()
vah_partialSortBy cmp a k = vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a k 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vah_partialSortBy #-}

-- | Moves the lowest k elements in the portion [l,u) of the array
-- into positions [l,k+l), sorted.
--
-- The remaining values in [l,u) will be in no particular order. Values outside
-- the range [l,u) will be unaffected.
vah_partialSortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ number of elements to vah_sort, k
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_partialSortByBounds cmp a k l u FILTER
  -- this potentially does more work than absolutely required,
  -- but using a heap to find the least 2 of 4 elements
  -- seems unlikely to be better than just sorting all of them
  -- with an optimal sort, and the latter is obviously index
  -- correct.
  | u <= l + k = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
  | otherwise  = do
      vah_selectByBounds cmp a k l u
      vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l + 4) (l + k)
      vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where
 len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_partialSortByBounds #-}

-- | Constructs a heap in a portion of an array [l, u), using the values
--   therein.
--
-- Note: 'vah_heapify' is more efficient than constructing a heap by repeated
-- insertion. Repeated insertion has complexity O(n*log n) while 'vah_heapify'
-- is able to construct a heap in O(n), where n is the number of elements in
-- the heap.
vah_heapify
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
 len = u - l
 loop k
   | k < 0     = return ()
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
                   vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u), swaps the
-- top of the heap with the element at u and rebuilds the heap.
vah_pop
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u) swaps the top
-- of the heap with the element at position t, and rebuilds the heap.
vah_popTo
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> Int -- ^ index to vah_pop to, t
  -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u), sorts the
-- highest values into [m,u). The elements in [l,m) are not in any
-- particular order.
vah_sortHeap
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ lower bound of final sorted portion, m
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

-- | Given a heap stored in a portion of an array [l,u) and an element e,
-- inserts the element into the heap, resulting in a heap in [l,u].
--
-- Note: it is best to only use this operation when incremental construction of
-- a heap is required. 'vah_heapify' is capable of building a heap in O(n) time,
-- while repeated insertion takes O(n*log n) time.
vah_heapInsert
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower heap index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper heap index, u
  -> e -- ^ element to be inserted, e
  -> m ()
vah_heapInsert cmp v l u e = sift (u - l)
 where
 sift k
   | k <= 0    = VGM.unsafeWrite v l e
   | otherwise = let pi = l + shiftR (k-1) 2
                  in VGM.unsafeRead v pi >>= \p -> case cmp p e of
                       LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite v (l + k) p >> sift pi
                       _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite v (l + k) e
{-# INLINE vah_heapInsert #-}

-- Rebuilds a heap with a hole in it from start downwards. Afterward,
-- the heap property should apply for [start + off, len + off). val
-- is the new value to be put in the hole.
vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac
               >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

-- Finds the maximum child of a heap node, given the indx of the first child.
vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default comparison for the type
vais_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e) =>
  v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vais_sort = vais_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vais_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a given comparison
vais_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vais_sortBy cmp a = vais_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vais_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of an array delimited by [l,u)
vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

-- | Sorts the portion of the array delimited by [l,u) under the assumption
-- that [l,m) is already sorted.
vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

-- Given a sorted array in [l,u), inserts val into its proper position,
-- yielding a sorted [l,u]
vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

-- | Sorts the elements at the positions 'off' and 'off + 1' in the given
-- array using the comparison.
vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}


-- | Sorts the elements at the two given indices using the comparison. This
-- is essentially a compare-and-swap, although the first index is assumed to
-- be the 'lower' of the two.
vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the three elements starting at the given offset in the array.
vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

-- | Sorts the elements at the three given indices. The indices are assumed
-- to be given from lowest to highest, so if 'l < m < u' then
-- 'vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a m l u' essentially sorts the median of three into the
-- lowest position in the array.
vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

-- | Sorts the four elements beginning at the offset.
vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

-- The horror...

-- | Sorts the elements at the four given indices. Like the 2 and 3 element
-- versions, this assumes that the indices are given in increasing order, so
-- it can be used to sort medians into particular positions and so on.
vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of

;;;
;;; Implicit treap
;;; (treap with implicit key)
;;;

;; Note:
;; - An empty treap is NIL.

(declaim (inline op))
(defun op (a b)
  "Is a binary operator comprising a monoid."
  (declare (uint62 a b))
  (min a b))

(defconstant +op-identity+ most-positive-fixnum
  "identity element w.r.t. OP")

(defstruct (itreap (:constructor %make-itreap (value priority &key left right (count 1) (accumulator value)))
                  (:copier nil)
                  (:conc-name %itreap-))
  (value +op-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (accumulator +op-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (priority 0 :type (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum))
  (count 1 :type (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum)) ; size of (sub)treap
  (left nil :type (or null itreap))
  (right nil :type (or null itreap)))

(declaim (inline itreap-count))
(defun itreap-count (itreap)
  "Returns the number of the elements."
  (declare ((or null itreap) itreap))
  (if itreap
      (%itreap-count itreap)
      0))

(declaim (inline itreap-accumulator))
(defun itreap-accumulator (itreap)
  "Returns the sum (w.r.t. OP) of the whole ITREAP:
ITREAP[0]+ITREAP[1]+...+ITREAP[SIZE-1]."
  (declare ((or null itreap) itreap))
  (if itreap
      (%itreap-accumulator itreap)
      +op-identity+))

(declaim (inline update-count))
(defun update-count (itreap)
  (declare (itreap itreap))
  (setf (%itreap-count itreap)
        (+ 1
           (itreap-count (%itreap-left itreap))
           (itreap-count (%itreap-right itreap)))))

(declaim (inline update-accumulator))
(defun update-accumulator (itreap)
  (declare (itreap itreap))
  (setf (%itreap-accumulator itreap)
        (if (%itreap-left itreap)
            (if (%itreap-right itreap)
                (let ((mid (op (%itreap-accumulator (%itreap-left itreap))
                               (%itreap-value itreap))))
                  (op mid (%itreap-accumulator (%itreap-right itreap))))
                (op (%itreap-accumulator (%itreap-left itreap))
                    (%itreap-value itreap)))
            (if (%itreap-right itreap)
                (op (%itreap-value itreap)
                    (%itreap-accumulator (%itreap-right itreap)))
                (%itreap-value itreap)))))

(declaim (inline force-up))
(defun force-up (itreap)
  "Propagates up the information from children."
  (declare (itreap itreap))
  (update-count itreap)
  (update-accumulator itreap))

(defun %heapify (top)
  "Properly swaps the priorities of the node and its two children."
  (declare (optimize (speed 3) (safety 0)))
  (when top
    (let ((high-priority-node top))
      (when (and (%itreap-left top)
                 (> (%itreap-priority (%itreap-left top))
                    (%itreap-priority high-priority-node)))
        (setq high-priority-node (%itreap-left top)))
      (when (and (%itreap-right top)
                 (> (%itreap-priority (%itreap-right top))
                    (%itreap-priority high-priority-node)))
        (setq high-priority-node (%itreap-right top)))
      (unless (eql high-priority-node top)
        (rotatef (%itreap-priority high-priority-node)
                 (%itreap-priority top))
        (%heapify high-priority-node)))))

(declaim (inline make-itreap))
(defun make-itreap (size &key initial-contents)
  "Makes a treap of SIZE in O(SIZE) time. Its values are filled with the
identity element unless INITIAL-CONTENTS are supplied."
  (declare ((or null vector) initial-contents))
  (labels ((build (l r)
             (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
             (if (= l r)
                 nil
                 (let* ((mid (ash (+ l r) -1))
                        (node (%make-itreap (if initial-contents
                                                (aref initial-contents mid)
                                                +op-identity+)
                                           (random most-positive-fixnum))))
                   (setf (%itreap-left node) (build l mid))
                   (setf (%itreap-right node) (build (+ mid 1) r))
                   (%heapify node)
                   (force-up node)
                   node))))
    (build 0 size)))

(defun itreap-split (itreap index)
  "Destructively splits the ITREAP into two nodes [0, INDEX) and [INDEX, N),
where N is the number of elements of the ITREAP."
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) index))
  (unless (<= index (itreap-count itreap))
    (error 'invalid-itreap-index-error :index index :itreap itreap))
  (labels ((recur (itreap ikey)
             (unless itreap
               (return-from itreap-split (values nil nil)))
             (let ((left-count (itreap-count (%itreap-left itreap))))
               (if (<= ikey left-count)
                   (multiple-value-bind (left right)
                       (itreap-split (%itreap-left itreap) ikey)
                     (setf (%itreap-left itreap) right)
                     (force-up itreap)
                     (values left itreap))
                   (multiple-value-bind (left right)
                       (itreap-split (%itreap-right itreap) (- ikey left-count 1))
                     (setf (%itreap-right itreap) left)
                     (force-up itreap)
                     (values itreap right))))))
    (recur itreap index)))

(defun itreap-merge (left right)
  "Destructively concatenates two ITREAPs."
  (declare #.OPT
           ((or null itreap) left right))
  (cond ((null left) (when right (force-up right)) right)
        ((null right) (when left (force-up left)) left)
        (t (if (> (%itreap-priority left) (%itreap-priority right))
               (progn
                 (setf (%itreap-right left)
                       (itreap-merge (%itreap-right left) right))
                 (force-up left)
                 left)
               (progn
                 (setf (%itreap-left right)
                       (itreap-merge left (%itreap-left right)))
                 (force-up right)
                 right)))))

(declaim (inline itreap-map))
(defun itreap-map (function itreap)
  "Successively applies FUNCTION to ITREAP[0], ..., ITREAP[SIZE-1]."
  (declare (function function))
  (labels ((recur (node)
             (when node
               (recur (%itreap-left node))
               (funcall function (%itreap-value node))
               (recur (%itreap-right node))
               (force-up node))))
    (recur itreap)))

(defmethod print-object ((object itreap) stream)
  (print-unreadable-object (object stream :type t)
    (let ((init t))
      (itreap-map (lambda (x)
                    (if init
                        (setq init nil)
                        (write-char #\  stream))
                   (write x :stream stream))
                 object))))

(declaim (inline itreap-ref))
(defun itreap-ref (itreap index)
  "Returns the element ITREAP[INDEX]."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) index))
  (unless (< index (itreap-count itreap))
    (error 'invalid-itreap-index-error :itreap itreap :index index))
  (labels ((%ref (itreap index)
             (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) index))
             (prog1
                 (let ((left-count (itreap-count (%itreap-left itreap))))
                   (cond ((< index left-count)
                          (%ref (%itreap-left itreap) index))
                         ((> index left-count)
                          (%ref (%itreap-right itreap) (- index left-count 1)))
                         (t (%itreap-value itreap))))
               (force-up itreap))))
    (%ref itreap index)))

(declaim (inline (setf itreap-ref)))
(defun (setf itreap-ref) (new-value itreap index)
  "Sets ITREAP[INDEX] to the given value."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) index))
  (unless (< index (itreap-count itreap))
    (error 'invalid-itreap-index-error :itreap itreap :index index))
  (labels ((%set (itreap index)
             (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) index))
             (prog1
                 (let ((left-count (itreap-count (%itreap-left itreap))))
                   (cond ((< index left-count)
                          (%set (%itreap-left itreap) index))
                         ((> index left-count)
                          (%set (%itreap-right itreap) (- index left-count 1)))
                         (t (setf (%itreap-value itreap) new-value))))
               (force-up itreap))))
    (%set itreap index)
    new-value))

(declaim (inline itreap-query))
(defun itreap-query (itreap l r)
  "Queries the `sum' (w.r.t. OP) of the range ITREAP[L, R)."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
  (unless (<= l r (itreap-count itreap))
    (error 'invalid-itreap-index-error :itreap itreap :index (cons l r)))
  (labels
      ((recur (itreap l r)
         (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
         (unless itreap
           (return-from recur +op-identity+))
         (prog1
             (if (and (zerop l) (= r (%itreap-count itreap)))
                 (itreap-accumulator itreap)
                 (let ((left-count (itreap-count (%itreap-left itreap))))
                   (if (<= l left-count)
                       (if (< left-count r)
                           ;; LEFT-COUNT is in [L, R)
                           (op (op (recur (%itreap-left itreap) l (min r left-count))
                                   (%itreap-value itreap))
                               (recur (%itreap-right itreap) 0 (- r left-count 1)))
                           ;; LEFT-COUNT is in [R, END)
                           (recur (%itreap-left itreap) l (min r left-count)))
                       ;; LEFT-COUNT is in [0, L)
                       (recur (%itreap-right itreap) (- l left-count 1) (- r left-count 1)))))
           (force-up itreap))))
    (recur itreap l r)))

;; FIXME: might be problematic when two priorities collide and START is not
;; zero. (It will be negligible from the viewpoint of probability, however.)
(declaim (inline itreap-range-bisect-left))
(defun itreap-range-bisect-left (itreap value order &optional (start 0))
  "Returns the smallest index that satisfies ITREAP[START]+ ITREAP[START+1] +
... + ITREAP[index] >= VALUE (if ORDER is #'<).

Note:
- This function handles a **closed** interval.
- This function returns the length of ITREAP instead if ITREAP[START]+
... +ITREAP[length-1] < VALUE.
- The prefix sums of ITREAP, (ITREAP[START], ITREAP[START]+ITREAP[START+1], ...)
  must be monotone w.r.t. ORDER.
- ORDER must be a strict order"
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) start))
  (multiple-value-bind (itreap-prefix itreap)
      (if (zerop start)
          (values nil itreap)
          (itreap-split itreap start))
    (labels
        ((recur (itreap offset prev-sum)
           (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) offset)
                    #+sbcl (values (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum)))
           (unless itreap
             (return-from recur offset))
           (let ((sum prev-sum))
             (prog1
                 (cond ((not (funcall order
                                      (setq sum (op sum (itreap-accumulator (%itreap-left itreap))))
                                      value))
                        (recur (%itreap-left itreap) offset prev-sum))
                       ((not (funcall order
                                      (setq sum (op sum (%itreap-value itreap)))
                                      value))
                        (+ offset (itreap-count (%itreap-left itreap))))
                       (t
                        (recur (%itreap-right itreap)
                               (+ offset (itreap-count (%itreap-left itreap)) 1)
                               sum)))
               (force-up itreap)))))
      (prog1 (+ start (recur itreap 0 +op-identity+))
        (itreap-merge itreap-prefix itreap)))))

(declaim (ftype (function * (values fixnum &optional)) read-fixnum))
(defun read-fixnum (&optional (in *standard-input*))
  (declare #.OPT)
  (macrolet ((%read-byte ()
               `(the (unsigned-byte 8)
                     #+swank (char-code (read-char in nil #\Nul))
                     #-swank (sb-impl::ansi-stream-read-byte in nil #.(char-code #\Nul) nil))))
    (let* ((minus nil)
           (result (loop (let ((byte (%read-byte)))
                           (cond ((<= 48 byte 57)
                                  (return (- byte 48)))
                                 ((zerop byte) ; #\Nul
                                  (error "Read EOF or #\Nul."))
                                 ((= byte #.(char-code #\-))
                                  (setf minus t)))))))
      (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) result))
      (loop
        (let* ((byte (%read-byte)))
          (if (<= 48 byte 57)
              (setq result (+ (- byte 48)
                              (* 10 (the (integer 0 #.(floor most-positive-fixnum 10)) result))))
              (return (if minus (- result) result))))))))

(declaim (inline delete-adjacent-duplicates))
(defun delete-adjacent-duplicates (seq &key (test #'eql))
  "Destructively deletes adjacent duplicates of SEQ: e.g. #(1 1 1 2 2 1 3) ->
#(1 2 1 3)"
  (declare (sequence seq)
           (function test))
  (etypecase seq
    (vector
     (if (zerop (length seq))
         seq
         (let ((prev (aref seq 0))
               (end 1))
           (loop for pos from 1 below (length seq)
                 unless (funcall test prev (aref seq pos))
                 do (setf prev (aref seq pos)
                          (aref seq end) (aref seq pos)
                          end (+ 1 end)))
           ;; KLUDGE: Resorting to ADJUST-ARRAY is maybe substandard. 
           (if (array-has-fill-pointer-p seq)
               (adjust-array seq end :fill-pointer end)
               (adjust-array seq end)))))
    (list
     (loop for rest on seq
           unless (and (cdr rest)
                       (funcall test (first rest) (second rest)))
           collect (car rest)))))

(defun println (obj &optional (stream *standard-output*))

(declaim (inline mop))
(defun mop (a b)
  "Is a binary moperator comprising a monoid."
  (declare (uint62 a b))
  (max a b))

(defconstant +mop-identity+ 0
  "identity element w.r.t. MOP")

(defstruct (mitreap (:constructor %make-mitreap (value priority &key left right (count 1) (accumulator value)))
                  (:copier nil)
                  (:conc-name %mitreap-))
  (value +mop-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (accumulator +mop-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (priority 0 :type (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum))
  (count 1 :type (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum)) ; size of (sub)treap
  (left nil :type (or null mitreap))
  (right nil :type (or null mitreap)))

(declaim (inline mitreap-count))
(defun mitreap-count (mitreap)
  "Returns the number of the elements."
  (declare ((or null mitreap) mitreap))
  (if mitreap
      (%mitreap-count mitreap)
      0))

(declaim (inline mitreap-accumulator))
(defun mitreap-accumulator (mitreap)
  "Returns the sum (w.r.t. MOP) of the whole MITREAP:
MITREAP[0]+MITREAP[1]+...+MITREAP[SIZE-1]."
  (declare ((or null mitreap) mitreap))
  (if mitreap
      (%mitreap-accumulator mitreap)
      +mop-identity+))

(declaim (inline mupdate-count))
(defun mupdate-count (mitreap)
  (declare (mitreap mitreap))
  (setf (%mitreap-count mitreap)
        (+ 1
           (mitreap-count (%mitreap-left mitreap))
           (mitreap-count (%mitreap-right mitreap)))))

(declaim (inline mupdate-accumulator))
(defun mupdate-accumulator (mitreap)
  (declare (mitreap mitreap))
  (setf (%mitreap-accumulator mitreap)
        (if (%mitreap-left mitreap)
            (if (%mitreap-right mitreap)
                (let ((mid (mop (%mitreap-accumulator (%mitreap-left mitreap))
                               (%mitreap-value mitreap))))
                  (mop mid (%mitreap-accumulator (%mitreap-right mitreap))))
                (mop (%mitreap-accumulator (%mitreap-left mitreap))
                    (%mitreap-value mitreap)))
            (if (%mitreap-right mitreap)
                (mop (%mitreap-value mitreap)
                    (%mitreap-accumulator (%mitreap-right mitreap)))
                (%mitreap-value mitreap)))))

(declaim (inline mforce-up))
(defun mforce-up (mitreap)
  "Propagates up the information from children."
  (declare (mitreap mitreap))
  (mupdate-count mitreap)
  (mupdate-accumulator mitreap))

(defun %mheapify (top)
  "Properly swaps the priorities of the node and its two children."
  (declare (optimize (speed 3) (safety 0)))
  (when top
    (let ((high-priority-node top))
      (when (and (%mitreap-left top)
                 (> (%mitreap-priority (%mitreap-left top))
                    (%mitreap-priority high-priority-node)))
        (setq high-priority-node (%mitreap-left top)))
      (when (and (%mitreap-right top)
                 (> (%mitreap-priority (%mitreap-right top))
                    (%mitreap-priority high-priority-node)))
        (setq high-priority-node (%mitreap-right top)))
      (unless (eql high-priority-node top)
        (rotatef (%mitreap-priority high-priority-node)
                 (%mitreap-priority top))
        (%mheapify high-priority-node)))))

(declaim (inline make-mitreap))
(defun make-mitreap (size &key initial-contents)
  "Makes a treap of SIZE in O(SIZE) time. Its values are filled with the
identity element unless INITIAL-CONTENTS are supplied."
  (declare ((or null vector) initial-contents))
  (labels ((build (l r)
             (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
             (if (= l r)
                 nil
                 (let* ((mid (ash (+ l r) -1))
                        (node (%make-mitreap (if initial-contents
                                                (aref initial-contents mid)
                                                +mop-identity+)
                                           (random most-positive-fixnum))))
                   (setf (%mitreap-left node) (build l mid))
                   (setf (%mitreap-right node) (build (+ mid 1) r))
                   (%mheapify node)
                   (mforce-up node)
                   node))))
    (build 0 size)))

(defun mitreap-split (mitreap index)
  "Destructively splits the MITREAP into two nodes [0, INDEX) and [INDEX, N),
where N is the number of elements of the MITREAP."
  (declare (optimize (speed 3))
           ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) index))
  (unless (<= index (mitreap-count mitreap))
    (error 'invalid-mitreap-index-error :index index :mitreap mitreap))
  (labels ((recur (mitreap ikey)
             (unless mitreap
               (return-from mitreap-split (values nil nil)))
             (let ((left-count (mitreap-count (%mitreap-left mitreap))))
               (if (<= ikey left-count)
                   (multiple-value-bind (left right)
                       (mitreap-split (%mitreap-left mitreap) ikey)
                     (setf (%mitreap-left mitreap) right)
                     (mforce-up mitreap)
                     (values left mitreap))
                   (multiple-value-bind (left right)
                       (mitreap-split (%mitreap-right mitreap) (- ikey left-count 1))
                     (setf (%mitreap-right mitreap) left)
                     (mforce-up mitreap)
                     (values mitreap right))))))
    (recur mitreap index)))

(defun mitreap-merge (left right)
  "Destructively concatenates two MITREAPs."
  (declare #.OPT
           ((or null mitreap) left right))
  (cond ((null left) (when right (mforce-up right)) right)
        ((null right) (when left (mforce-up left)) left)
        (t (if (> (%mitreap-priority left) (%mitreap-priority right))
               (progn
                 (setf (%mitreap-right left)
                       (mitreap-merge (%mitreap-right left) right))
                 (mforce-up left)
                 left)
               (progn
                 (setf (%mitreap-left right)
                       (mitreap-merge left (%mitreap-left right)))
                 (mforce-up right)
                 right)))))

(declaim (inline mitreap-map))
(defun mitreap-map (function mitreap)
  "Successively applies FUNCTION to MITREAP[0], ..., MITREAP[SIZE-1]."
  (declare (function function))
  (labels ((recur (node)
             (when node
               (recur (%mitreap-left node))
               (funcall function (%mitreap-value node))
               (recur (%mitreap-right node))
               (mforce-up node))))
    (recur mitreap)))

                        (write-char #\  stream))

                 object))))

(declaim (inline mitreap-ref))
(defun mitreap-ref (mitreap index)
  "Returns the element MITREAP[INDEX]."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) index))
  (unless (< index (mitreap-count mitreap))
    (error 'invalid-mitreap-index-error :mitreap mitreap :index index))
  (labels ((%ref (mitreap index)

                         ((> index left-count)
                          (%ref (%mitreap-right mitreap) (- index left-count 1)))
                         (t (%mitreap-value mitreap))))
               (mforce-up mitreap))))
    (%ref mitreap index)))

(declaim (inline (setf mitreap-ref)))
(defun (setf mitreap-ref) (new-value mitreap index)
  "Sets MITREAP[INDEX] to the given value."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) index))
  (unless (< index (mitreap-count mitreap))
    (error 'invalid-mitreap-index-error :mitreap mitreap :index index))
  (labels ((%set (mitreap index)
             (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) index))

                 (let ((left-count (mitreap-count (%mitreap-left mitreap))))

                          (%set (%mitreap-left mitreap) index))
                         ((> index left-count)
                          (%set (%mitreap-right mitreap) (- index left-count 1)))
                         (t (setf (%mitreap-value mitreap) new-value))))
               (mforce-up mitreap))))
    (%set mitreap index)
    new-value))

(declaim (inline mitreap-query))
(defun mitreap-query (mitreap l r)
  "Queries the `sum' (w.r.t. MOP) of the range MITREAP[L, R)."
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
  (unless (<= l r (mitreap-count mitreap))
    (error 'invalid-mitreap-index-error :mitreap mitreap :index (cons l r)))
  (labels
      ((recur (mitreap l r)
         (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
         (unless mitreap
           (return-from recur +mop-identity+))
         (prog1
             (if (and (zerop l) (= r (%mitreap-count mitreap)))
                 (mitreap-accumulator mitreap)
                 (let ((left-count (mitreap-count (%mitreap-left mitreap))))
                   (if (<= l left-count)
                       (if (< left-count r)
                           ;; LEFT-COUNT is in [L, R)
                           (mop (mop (recur (%mitreap-left mitreap) l (min r left-count))
                                   (%mitreap-value mitreap))
                               (recur (%mitreap-right mitreap) 0 (- r left-count 1)))
                           ;; LEFT-COUNT is in [R, END)
                           (recur (%mitreap-left mitreap) l (min r left-count)))
                       ;; LEFT-COUNT is in [0, L)
                       (recur (%mitreap-right mitreap) (- l left-count 1) (- r left-count 1)))))
           (mforce-up mitreap))))
    (recur mitreap l r)))

;; FIXME: might be problematic when two priorities collide and START is not
;; zero. (It will be negligible from the viewpoint of probability, however.)
(declaim (inline mitreap-range-bisect-left))
(defun mitreap-range-bisect-left (mitreap value order &optional (start 0))
  "Returns the smallest index that satisfies MITREAP[START]+ MITREAP[START+1] +
... + MITREAP[index] >= VALUE (if ORDER is #'<).

Note:
- This function handles a **closed** interval.
- This function returns the length of MITREAP instead if MITREAP[START]+
... +MITREAP[length-1] < VALUE.
- The prefix sums of MITREAP, (MITREAP[START], MITREAP[START]+MITREAP[START+1], ...)
  must be monotone w.r.t. ORDER.
- ORDER must be a strict order"
  (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) start))
  (multiple-value-bind (mitreap-prefix mitreap)
      (if (zerop start)
          (values nil mitreap)
          (mitreap-split mitreap start))
    (labels
        ((recur (mitreap offset prev-sum)
           (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) offset)
                    #+sbcl (values (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum)))
           (unless mitreap
             (return-from recur offset))
           (let ((sum prev-sum))
             (prog1
                 (cond ((not (funcall order
                                      (setq sum (mop sum (mitreap-accumulator (%mitreap-left mitreap))))
                                      value))
                        (recur (%mitreap-left mitreap) offset prev-sum))
                       ((not (funcall order
                                      (setq sum (mop sum (%mitreap-value mitreap)))
                                      value))
                        (+ offset (mitreap-count (%mitreap-left mitreap))))
                       (t
                        (recur (%mitreap-right mitreap)
                               (+ offset (mitreap-count (%mitreap-left mitreap)) 1)
                               sum)))
               (mforce-up mitreap)))))
      (prog1 (+ start (recur mitreap 0 +mop-identity+))
        (mitreap-merge mitreap-prefix mitreap)))))

(defun main ()
  (let* ((n (read))
         (as (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (bs (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (pairs (make-array n :element-type '(cons uint32 uint32))))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((a (read-fixnum)))
        (setf (aref as i) a)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((b (read-fixnum)))
        (setf (aref bs i) b)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (setf (aref pairs i)
            (cons (aref as i) (aref bs i))))
    (setq pairs (sort pairs (lambda (x y) (< (the uint31 x) (the uint31 y))) :key #'cdr))
    (let ((new-as (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
          (sorted-as (sort (copy-seq as) #'<))
          (sorted-bs (sort (copy-seq bs) #'<)))
      (declare ((simple-array uint31 (*)) sorted-as sorted-bs))
      (dotimes (i n)
        (setf (aref new-as i) (car (aref pairs i))))
      (when (loop for a across sorted-as
                  for b across sorted-bs
                  thereis (> a b))
        (write-line "No")
        (return-from main))
      (when (< (length (delete-adjacent-duplicates (copy-seq sorted-as)))
               n)
        (write-line "Yes")
        (return-from main))
      (let ((dp (make-itreap n :initial-contents new-as))
            (pos 0)
            (count 0))
        (loop (when (= count (- n 2))
                (return))
              ;; (loop while (and (< pos n)
              ;;                  (<= (itreap-ref dp pos) (aref sorted-bs pos)))
              ;;       do (incf pos))
              ;; (when (= pos n)
              ;;   (return))
              (let* ((new-min (itreap-query dp pos n))
                     (min-pos (itreap-range-bisect-left dp (aref sorted-bs pos) #'> pos)))
                (declare (uint62 new-min min-pos))
                (unless (= min-pos pos)
                  (rotatef (itreap-ref dp pos)
                           (itreap-ref dp min-pos))
                  (incf count))
                (incf pos)))
        (when (loop for i below n
                    always (<= (itreap-ref dp i) (aref sorted-bs i)))
          (write-line "Yes")
          (return-from main)))
